facts.fact: Director General of Health Walid Naija announced the unique medical record is being generalised in the majority of public hospitals across all regions.
At the Hammamet digital health forum on 3 April 2026, Walid Naija said the record would be extended to dispensaries, basic health centres and schools and universities.
